stock.description: Charmacy Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. serves as a prominent distributor of pharmaceutical products across the People's Republic of China. The company's comprehensive portfolio includes Western medications, traditional Chinese patent medicines, and various healthcare items, along with associated advisory services. These are supplied to both wholesale distributors and retail pharmacies. Furthermore, Charmacy operates "Charmacy e-Medicine," its proprietary B2B digital platform, which enables clients to efficiently place orders, make inquiries, and process payments online. Founded in 1984, the firm maintains its headquarters in Shantou, PRC. It was formerly known as Chuangmei Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. until its official renaming to Charmacy Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. in July 2016.
